objects.name: Find objects and their roles
objects.description: Choose connectivity, background, and which pixels belong together.

panels.name: Split into panels or logical cells
panels.description: Treat separators and blocks as a higher-level grid.

selection.name: Select by attributes or relations
selection.description: Select the relevant object by size, frequency, shape, or a comparison.

legend.name: Decode markers, legends, or symbols
legend.description: A colour or shape specifies another operation, object, or parameter.

recolour.name: Recolour or substitute colours
recolour.description: Change labels while preserving selected geometry.

rigid.name: Rotate, reflect, transpose
rigid.description: Infer an orientation or symmetry axis, then map coordinates.

movement.name: Move, align, or dock objects
movement.description: Choose displacement and destination; preserve object identity.

repeat.name: Repeat, extrapolate, or alternate
repeat.description: Infer a period, phase, or growth rule and continue it.

template.name: Match and copy a template
template.description: Recognize a prototype and transfer its structure elsewhere.

repair.name: Reconstruct missing or damaged content
repair.description: Infer absent information from symmetry, repetition, or another instance.

topology.name: Enclosure, holes, and flood fill
topology.description: Distinguish inside/outside and connected background regions.

paths.name: Connect endpoints or traverse a graph
paths.description: Build or follow connections with turns, branches, and endpoints.

rays.name: Project rays and extend lines
rays.description: Propagate directionally until a boundary, collision, or stopping marker.

dynamics.name: Simulate motion and interactions
dynamics.description: Apply state transitions whose result depends on obstacles and previous events.

count.name: Count, measure, and encode quantities
count.description: Turn quantities into dimensions, colours, repetitions, or positions.

order.name: Sort or infer an execution order
order.description: Order objects or instructions by a task-specific key.

boolean.name: Combine masks or compare panels
boolean.description: Use occupancy agreement, difference, union, or intersection.

crop.name: Extract a region or change the canvas
crop.description: Infer what region to return and its coordinate system.

scale.name: Scale or build a grid of grids
scale.description: Map individual cells to objects or objects to logical cells.

assembly.name: Constraint search and assembly
assembly.description: Search orientations or placements that jointly satisfy the task constraints.

layers.name: Reason about layers and overlap
layers.description: Handle nested levels, rendering order, or hidden structure.

instructions.name: Execute a symbolic program
instructions.description: Interpret symbols as ordered operations with state.

analogy.name: Infer an embedded example relationship
analogy.description: Infer a transformation within the input and apply it to another part.
